identity.name: Devmora Web Solutions
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Corporate Reliability with Digital Artistry
Content is King: Every service page tells a story of success
Negative Space: Luxury is defined by what you leave out
Contrast: Navy vs Gold, Serif vs Sans

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500

usage.gradients: Use subtle gradients only: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-slate-100

buttons.primary: bg-[#1a2b4a] text-white hover:bg-[#243b53] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1a2b4a] border border-[#1a2b4a]/20 hover:border-[#1a2b4a] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-[#1a2b4a] hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

cards.service: group relative overflow-hidden bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 p-8 hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-1
cards.product: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group
cards.glass: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/40 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-xl

inputs.default: flex h-12 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-white file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#1a2b4a] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

assets.icons: Use Lucide React icons. For services, use thin stroke weights (1.5px) to match the elegant aesthetic.

phase_1_setup: Update tailwind.config.js with new colors and fonts
Add Satoshi font files to public/fonts directory
Add @font-face declarations for all Satoshi weights in index.css
Preload critical font files (Regular, Medium, Bold) in index.html
phase_2_components: Create 'Section' wrapper component with standard padding
Customize Shadcn Button, Input, and Select to match 'Old Money Tech' style
phase_3_pages: Build Homepage with 'Tetris Grid' hero section
Build Services page with detailed iconography
Build Marketplace with sidebar filters and grid layout
Build Product Detail page with sticky purchase card

universal_guidelines: Use Satoshi font family consistently across all text elements.
Do not use generic full-screen gradients. Use white space and subtle mesh gradients.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (color shift or lift).
Mobile-first: Stack grids on mobile, expand on desktop.
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1. Use darker slate colors for text on white.
